sources: Curated build metadata (PLAN.md sections 5, 7). Clip names are the human-readable names LanternExtractor emits for classic EQ animation clips; candidates are listed in priority order and the first one present in the uploaded model is used. Frame fractions are provisional and tuned visually for how each reads as a frozen figurine.

poses.label: Standing
poses.notes: Safe default; compact and balanced, the most printable pose.

poses.label: Waving
poses.notes: One arm raised; introduces an overhang and a small balance shift.

poses.label: Saluting
poses.notes: Arm to head; watch the hand does not fuse to the face on remesh.

poses.label: Bowing
poses.notes: Social greeting; a stable, self-supporting pose.

poses.label: Attacking
poses.notes: Weapon extended; long overhang and a thin blade — usually wants a base.

poses.label: Casting
poses.notes: Arms out; dramatic but the hardest to print (overhangs, balance).
